cases.assertion: The explicit recommended timeline orders visible posts by follow, recent tag interactions and age; feedback hides or demotes the same targets as before. Anonymous results use stable recency order, and other timelines and searches keep their existing behavior.

An authenticated member can page through recent group posts with the group name. A logged-out viewer receives 401 and missing or revoked membership, disabled groups or authors, removed posts and blocked authors never appear.
Web and Flutter switch among recommended, following, trending and group activity, keep each response in its tab and discard previous-account results.
